t: The MCP Chronicles: A Case Study in Progressive Enhancement
s: This article details Pipulate's transition to a modular, self-discovering plugin architecture for AI, emphasizing the 'golden path' concept for AI orientation and a bedrock stack of Linux, Python, and Git for reliable execution, advocating for progressive enhancement in tool-calling.
sub: Bedrock stack: Linux, Python, Git for reliable AI execution
Progressive enhancement in AI tool-calling protocols (MCP vs. simpler)
Cognitive load management for AI ('Rule of Seven')
